nodes.label: Knowledge Bundle Index (specification, conventions, decisions, reference)
Normative Specification Section (§0 Clarify → §7 Report & commit)
Lifecycle Record Design (non-normative, conflicts with spec on purpose)
nodes.rationale: Indexed as a Decision that deliberately conflicts with parts of the specification; §10 lists every conflict pending amendment after the implementation is accepted, so the conflict is intentional and recorded rather than avoided.

nodes.label: Artifact Type Definitions (unit of definition for structure, relations, validation, evaluation)
nodes.rationale: The artifact type is the declared unit of definition for structure, relations, mechanical validation rules and evaluation criteria; structure and the rule mechanism are designed while rule content and the judgment half remain undesigned, and the index records that asymmetry rather than hiding it.
